fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-06-25, around 00:00, a group of persons allegedly attacked the complainant at Nila Puram Main Street in Ernakulam, causing injuries that required treatment, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-06-25. Tamilarasan Palanisamy submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000023. Babu Rajan (9000000365) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Mathan Chandran (9000000343), described as a relative of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. A car bearing the number KL-07-XX-1012 was seen leaving the area. A person named Abirami Raj, associated with the number 9000000141, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Group allegedly confronted the victim following an earlier dispute.
fields.Keywords: group assault, injury, car, mobile number, photograph, associate, night, witness
